title: handover — the unfinished, uncommitted work a colleague left in the tree

files.description: CHECKABLE — every untracked file left behind, with its exact contents. This manifest IS the handover: each node runs in its own disposable microVM, so the files themselves cannot survive to the next step and are re-staged there from this list.

content.description: The file's exact contents. The final step consumes these bytes and compares them against what survived downstream.

summary.description: JUDGMENT — where the colleague got to and what is left to do. Never adjudicated.
